text:
```yaml
name: Azure Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Create deployment script
      run: |
        echo '#!/bin/bash' > deploy.sh
        echo 'echo "Deploying to Azure"' >> deploy.sh
        echo 'az webapp publish <your-app-name> --resource-group <your-resource-group>' >> deploy.sh
        chmod +x deploy.sh

    - name: Deploy to Azure
      run: ./deploy.sh
      env:
        AZURE_APP_NAME: ${{ secrets.AZURE_APP_NAME }}
        AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP: ${{ secrets.AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP }}
        AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
        AZURE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
        AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
        AZURE_TENANT_ID: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: deployment-log
        path: deployment.log
```

Please note that you need to replace `<your-app-name>` and `<your-resource-group>` with your actual Azure Web App name and resource group. Also, make sure to add the necessary secrets (`AZURE_APP_NAME`, `AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP`, `AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID`, `AZURE_CLIENT_ID`, `AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `AZURE_TENANT_ID`) to your repository settings under Secrets.
